name: Shocked!
source:
Shocked! is a visual novel focused on Maddie, a girl who loves gossip and is unhappy with her job as a postman. Discover the mysteries of this post-monarch medieval fantasy while she figures out what to do with her life. 

[From [url=https://michelmiron.itch.io/shocked-part-01]Itch.io[/url]]
